decisions.quote: Jones and Westoff (1979) reported a study of fertility trends among white women in intact first marriages. They found that the fertility of white Catholic and non-Catholic wives was converging. The differential had all but disappeared, as had the differential by frequency of communion among Catholic wives. We replicated their study using data from the 1976 National Survey of Family Growth.
decisions.reason: The exact primary abstract names Jones/Westoff1979 and Catholic/non-Catholic fertility convergence and communion-frequency comparisons, matching shipped2255; reversed author order and missing blind title/DOI are metadata differences, not a new original. Parent independently read the primary description and all supplied shipped identities. Bind the existing original, without adding a duplicate pair or inferring an unrequested outcome.
